bug_semantics: The authenticated /v1/completions endpoint accepted an attacker-chosen outer list of text prompts or token-id prompt lists. The serving path preserved that outer cardinality, created one engine generator and request ID per element, merged all generators, and allocated streaming or non-streaming response state proportional to the number of prompts. Per-prompt token and sampling limits therefore did not bound aggregate CPU, memory, scheduler, asynchronous-task, or response-buffer work initiated by one HTTP request.
flaw_origin: PR #2529 deliberately enabled batch completions. Its first member commit d04fd49c2bc9540237d3d11b6d1de26bbc35d232 removed the immediate-parent rejection of len(prompts) > 1 and added the complete unbounded fan-out mechanism: a generators list, a loop over every prompt, one engine.generate call per element, merge_async_iterators(*generators), and response arrays sized by prompt count. The second member a3a405c6a2b2f259671c5034c9a14e28187e97ac only added type annotations. The main-branch commit 3a7dd7e367277c47472912e84375fa912df07328 is the squash aggregate, not the smallest BIC; later imports, moves, and refactors merely preserved the mechanism and are also rejected as origins.
ai_marker: absent: git cat-file -p d04fd49c2bc9540237d3d11b6d1de26bbc35d232 shows author and committer simon-mo <simon.mo@hey.com> and only the message 'Support Batch Completion in Server'; the BIC commit object contains no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI-tool trailer, bot identity, or other AI marker.
evidence: The assigned first-party advisory bundle identifies CVE-2026-73559/GHSA-87x5-vmc3-756j, vulnerable pip versions >=0.19.0 and <0.26.0, first patched version 0.26.0, PR #47845, and the landed fix commit 675f4295cdfe0d870471c2b51bfeca3a68a9569e. It describes the same outer-list-to-one-engine-request-per-element fan-out.

Direct parent check: git cat-file -p d04fd49c2bc9540237d3d11b6d1de26bbc35d232 names sole parent 2709c0009aa434fbf2ef0fe48ca3094a2268b190. git grep at that parent finds the explicit 'Batching in completion API is not supported.' rejection and finds none of merge_async_iterators, generators = [], or the loop over prompts. git grep at d04fd49c2bc9540237d3d11b6d1de26bbc35d232 finds merge_async_iterators at lines 205 and 291, generators = [] at line 269, and for i, prompt in enumerate(prompts) at line 274; git show confirms that this commit deletes the parent guard and adds the per-prompt engine.generate loop and prompt-count-sized response state.

Squash decomposition check: git cat-file -p a3a405c6a2b2f259671c5034c9a14e28187e97ac names d04fd49c2bc9540237d3d11b6d1de26bbc35d232 as its parent and message 'Add type hint'; git show changes only annotations in serving_completion.py. git cat-file -p 3a7dd7e367277c47472912e84375fa912df07328 shows the later GitHub landing 'Support Batch Completion in Server (#2529)'. Thus d04fd49c2bc9540237d3d11b6d1de26bbc35d232 is the smallest causal PR member, while the squash aggregate and later moves/imports are not BICs.

BIC-only AI check: the raw d04fd49c2bc9540237d3d11b6d1de26bbc35d232 commit object has matching human author and committer identities and no body or trailer after its title. No PR-body disclosure, branch name, later refactor, or fix metadata is used for attribution.

The assigned fix topic contains one actual conflict: both audits set fix_sha to landed commit 675f4295cdfe0d870471c2b51bfeca3a68a9569e, but the primary also set direct_fix_sha to that squash while the reviewer set direct_fix_sha to f31ca6b5b948c5b7747e1ca4a04abfd9a7d87eca. Re-run object checks show f31ca6b5b948c5b7747e1ca4a04abfd9a7d87eca is the direct authored fix with parent 1e823dc01d5c3f396ce810afc2daa33c79d9a201, whereas 675f4295cdfe0d870471c2b51bfeca3a68a9569e is the GitHub landing with parent d99adcebdc9402c26346230ef2480d1cb72e654e and title ending '(#47845)'. git merge-base --is-ancestor confirms f31ca6b5b948c5b7747e1ca4a04abfd9a7d87eca is not an ancestor of the squash landing, so the two roles must not be collapsed.

Patch identity resolves the disagreement: git show --format= --binary for each of f31ca6b5b948c5b7747e1ca4a04abfd9a7d87eca and 675f4295cdfe0d870471c2b51bfeca3a68a9569e piped to git patch-id --stable produces the identical patch ID 7c28dda294962cd11f2832d8daaa77a596f0a5d9. git diff-tree shows both modify exactly tests/entrypoints/openai/completion/test_completion_error.py, vllm/entrypoints/openai/completion/protocol.py, and vllm/envs.py. Current refs/pull/47845/head resolves to 03d174a27f12cde10b722d4afa026fae5e8f0151, and its first-parent history reaches f31ca6b5b948c5b7747e1ca4a04abfd9a7d87eca before two main-branch merge updates. Therefore the reviewer is correct for direct_fix_sha, while the primary is correct only for the landed fix_sha.

Fix parent and mechanism check: git grep finds no VLLM_MAX_COMPLETION_PROMPTS in either the direct fix parent 1e823dc01d5c3f396ce810afc2daa33c79d9a201 or the landing parent d99adcebdc9402c26346230ef2480d1cb72e654e. At f31ca6b5b948c5b7747e1ca4a04abfd9a7d87eca, git show adds a before-model validator that distinguishes a flat token-id prompt from an outer prompt list and rejects oversized prompt and prompt_embeds lists before rendering or generator allocation, adds the configurable VLLM_MAX_COMPLETION_PROMPTS default of 1024, and adds boundary regression coverage.

Version boundary check: v0.19.0 resolves to 2a69949bdadf0e8942b7a1619b229cb475beef20; its merge base with squash landing 3a7dd7e367277c47472912e84375fa912df07328 is that landing, and its completion serving source still calls merge_async_iterators(*generators), matching the advisory's affected lower boundary. v0.25.0 resolves to 702f4814fe54fabff350d43cb753ae3e47c0c276; its merge base with 675f4295cdfe0d870471c2b51bfeca3a68a9569e is earlier commit 6db31c8e76f5458177be0d716cca758e51fa2f65 and git grep finds no VLLM_MAX_COMPLETION_PROMPTS. v0.26.0 resolves to 568afb3a13806beb53bb2e6bd518269357b237c0; its merge base with the landed fix is the fix itself, and git grep finds the new validator and environment limit in that release. This proves the <0.26.0/0.26.0 vulnerable-to-patched boundary.
reasoning: The smallest real BIC is d04fd49c2bc9540237d3d11b6d1de26bbc35d232 because its immediate parent still rejects multiple prompts and the child itself removes that invariant while creating the complete unbounded fan-out path. The typing-only PR member, mainline squash aggregate, and later moves/refactors are not smaller causal origins. The fix disagreement is resolved by separating the original direct patch from its landed squash: f31ca6b5b948c5b7747e1ca4a04abfd9a7d87eca is the direct authored PR fix, and 675f4295cdfe0d870471c2b51bfeca3a68a9569e is its patch-equivalent mainline landing referenced by the advisory and contained in v0.26.0. Consequently the reviewer's direct_fix_sha wins and the primary's claim that the landing is also the direct fix is wrong; both were already correct about fix_sha itself. The parent checks and v0.25.0/v0.26.0 boundary show the fix is real and complete. The BIC commit object has no AI signal, so the gate-complete verdict is NOT_AI.
